families.certificate_schema: SplitVecCert + SimdLaneUBGuardCert (shift < bw, div != 0, sdiv MIN/-1)

ub_preconditions.simd_shl_shr: Immediate UB if any lane shift count >= lane_bitwidth or < 0
ub_preconditions.simd_div_rem: Immediate UB if any lane divisor == 0, or signed INT_MIN / -1
ub_preconditions.simd_ctlz_cttz: Calls @llvm.ctlz/@llvm.cttz with is_zero_poison = i1 false (defined at 0)

families.split_512_to_128_neon_i686: 4x 128-bit independent register ops (Split4 via 2 recursive Split2 steps)

ub_preconditions.simd_saturating_add_sub: Total on all integer bit patterns (@llvm.sadd.sat / @llvm.uadd.sat)
ub_preconditions.simd_arith_offset: Wrapping vector getelementptr (preserves per-lane pointer provenance without inbounds UB)

families.split_512_to_128_neon_i686: uqadd/sqadd on 4x v4i32 NEON; paddusb/psubusb or icmp+select on SSE2

ub_preconditions.simd_eq_to_ge: Emits icmp/fcmp -> sext <N x i1> to <N x iM> (returns -1 for true, 0 for false)
ub_preconditions.simd_select: Checks mask lanes (CTFE/Miri require each lane to be 0 or -1; LLVM truncates LSB to i1)
ub_preconditions.simd_bitmask: Bitcasts <N x i1> to integer/byte array (bit order reversed via @llvm.bitreverse on big-endian)

families.split_512_to_128_neon_i686: Split2/Split4 slices integer bitmask via (mask & ((1<<W)-1), mask >> W)

ub_preconditions.simd_as: Float-to-int uses @llvm.fptosi.sat / @llvm.fptoui.sat (clamps NaN->0 and out-of-range to MIN/MAX; never UB)
ub_preconditions.simd_cast: Float-to-int emits raw fptosi / fptoui (out-of-range or NaN/Inf produces poison/UB!)

families.split_512_to_128_neon_i686: Widening casts split output into 2x/4x registers; narrowing casts pack pairs via xtn/packssdw

ub_preconditions.simd_insert_extract: Immediate UB if runtime lane index >= N
ub_preconditions.simd_shuffle: Const index array [u32; M] with all indices < 2*N

families.split_512_to_128_neon_i686: AArch64 lowers 2/4-reg shuffle to tbl v0.16b, {v0..v3}; x86 AVX2 uses vperm2i128 + vpblendd

ub_preconditions.ordered_float_reduce: Folds lanes strictly left-to-right starting from acc (@llvm.vector.reduce.fadd/fmul without reassoc)
ub_preconditions.unordered_float_reduce: Permits tree reassociation across split halves

families.split_512_to_128_neon_i686: Ordered fold threads scalar acc sequentially through Split4 chunks (acc0 -> acc1 -> acc2 -> acc3)

ub_preconditions.masked_load_gather: Inactive mask lanes suppress page faults and Tree Borrows reads; active lanes must be aligned per SimdAlign
ub_preconditions.simd_scatter: Overlapping active lane addresses have target-defined write order; disjoint active lanes commute deterministically

families.split_512_to_128_neon_i686: AArch64 NEON & i686 SSE2 legalize masked load/store/gather/scatter into predicated scalar lane-branch diamonds

ub_preconditions.simd_fma_ vs_fmuladd: simd_fma guarantees single rounding (@llvm.fma); simd_fmuladd permits fused or unfused (@llvm.fmuladd)

families.split_512_to_128_neon_i686: Hardware vector ops for fabs/fsqrt/round/fma; scalar libm loop for sin/cos/exp/log/pow without SVML
